		./genlink_realtek.sh; \

		rm -f include/config.mk; \

		echo "$(Config_DTE_Bootcode_Config_Value) $(Config_DTE_Bootcode_ARCH_Value) $(Config_DTE_Bootcode_CPU_Value) $(Config_DTE_Bootcode_Board_name_Value) $(Config_DTE_Bootcode_Vendor_Value) $(Config_DTE_Bootcode_SOC_Value) $(Config_DTE_Bootcode_Options_Value)" > boards.cfg; \

		$(CP) $(U_BOOT_BIN) $(U_BOOT_TARGET); \
		$(CP) $(U_BOOT_ELF) $(U_BOOT_ELF_TARGET); \
		$(CP) $(U_BOOT_MAP) $(U_BOOT_DIS) $(U_BOOT_SREC) ./; \

#!/bin/sh

# force remove symbolic link
rm -f ./uboot/board/realtek
rm -f ./uboot/arch/arm/cpu/armv7/realtek
rm -f ./uboot/arch/arm/include/asm/arch-realtek
rm -f ./uboot/lib/rtk
rm -rf ./uboot/include/rtk
rm -f ./uboot/common/rtk
rm -f ./uboot/drivers/rtk

mkdir ./uboot/include/rtk
# add symbolic link for bsp
echo "Generate link for board   ... realtek"
ln -fs ../../bsp/board/realtek/ ./uboot/board/realtek

echo "Generate link for arch    ... realtek"
ln -fs ../../../../../bsp/arch/realtek/ ./uboot/arch/arm/cpu/armv7/realtek
ln -fs ../../../../../bsp/arch/include/arch-realtek/ ./uboot/arch/arm/include/asm/arch-realtek

echo "Generate link for lib     ... rtk"
ln -fs ../../bsp/core/src/lib/ ./uboot/lib/rtk
ls bsp/core/include/* | xargs -I FILES ln -sf ../../../FILES ./uboot/include/rtk/

echo "Generate link for common  ... rtk"
ln -fs ../../bsp/core/cmd ./uboot/common/rtk

echo "Generate link for drivers  ... rtk"
ln -fs ../../bsp/core/src/drivers ./uboot/drivers/rtk

echo "Generate link for customer  ... rtk"
ls customer/include/* | xargs -I FILES ln -sf ../../../FILES ./uboot/include/rtk/
